notes:
What's new in DuckOS 1.0.109

• Lock screen notifications, stacked like on an iPhone: only the newest shows, with the others behind it. Swipe up on them to see them all (scroll if there are many), pull down at the top to stack them again, and swipe down on the stack to tuck them away behind a small "notifications" count. Swipe or tap that to bring them back.
• Android's old lock screen no longer shows: the back gesture doesn't leave DuckOS's lock screen, and if the screen comes on without it, it comes back.
• Home screen: move an app and every other app stays exactly where it is. Drop it on another app and the two swap; drop it on a widget and it goes to the nearest free spot.
